text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Who do you think's taking today's Kawasaki Kinen?
My bet's totally on Hokko Tarumae!”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No way, Wonder Acute's far from done.
She's definitely gonna show us what a veteran's made of.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...The flow of ki is different from the Champions Cup?
What could be causing this disturbance...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a fifty-fifty whether it's a bad omen or not, I guess.
Do your best, Tarumae—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
This social media post looks good to go.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to deliver results...!
I'll build momentum from here and earn my shot at challenging Falco-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Through an extraordinary amount of effort in such a short time, Hokko Tarumae arrived at the Kawasaki Kinen in magnificent form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And above all, her fighting spirit is tremendous.
She's burning with a stronger desire to produce results
than ever before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...That is precisely why I can't help feeling anxious.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Praying that those tense, swelling emotions
would not burst,
I saw Hokko Tarumae off—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae--!!
Do your best--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're the next one up after Smart Falcon!!
Give it everything you've got—!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah.
I can hear everyone in the crowd really well today.)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Compared to the Champions Cup,
I can feel how much more fulfilling this is...!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, impressive.
You've grown remarkably sharp in such a short time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san.
I fully intend to deliver results today.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's the way it should be.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we begin?
Round one of waking the red ogre—
